content:
{'content': '昨日 Apple 推出了 27.2 嘅新開發者測試版本，而今日公開測試嘅用戶都可以更新到新版本。以下係 iPadOS 27.2 公開測試版 2 嘅新功能介紹。', 'translation': "Apple yesterday rolled out a new developer beta of 27.2, and public beta testers can now update to the new version as well. Here's what's new in iPadOS 27.2 public beta 2."}

{'content': '最新嘅 27.2 測試版為 Apple TV 4K 同 HomePod 加入咗設計改動同埋一啲隱藏嘅新功能。', 'translation': 'The latest 27.2 beta brings design changes and some hidden new features to the Apple TV 4K and HomePod.'}

{'content': '如果你已經加入咗 Apple 嘅公開測試計劃（beta.apple.com），Apple 今日起就會陸續推出新嘅測試版本更新。', 'translation': "If you're already signed up for Apple's public beta program at beta.apple.com, Apple will begin rolling out the new beta updates starting today."}

{'content': 'iPadOS 27.2 公開測試版 2 已經可以下載，而 tvOS 27.2、HomePod 27.2 等系統嘅測試版亦都會陸續推出。', 'translation': 'iPadOS 27.2 public beta 2 is now available for download, while betas for tvOS 27.2, HomePod 27.2, and other systems will be rolling out陆续.'}

{'content': '今次推出嘅軟件版本同昨日畀開發者嘅測試版 3 完全相同。', 'translation': "This software release is identical to yesterday's developer beta 3."}

{'content': '今次測試版中有啲較細微嘅變化，包括 Apple Books 嘅設計更新、Apple Music 嘅新標誌，以及幾個應用程式加入咗介紹新功能嘅開機畫面。', 'translation': 'This beta includes some subtle changes, such as a design refresh for Apple Books, a new logo for Apple Music, and splash screens introducing new features in a handful of apps.'}

{'content': '更值得留意嘅係，最新測試版嘅程式碼入面發現咗 Apple TV 4K 同 HomePod 嘅新功能，預計會喺下星期公布。不過公開測試版嘅用戶暫時睇唔到呢啲功能，因為相關程式碼要等 Apple 正式公布後先會開放。', 'translation': "More notably, the latest beta's code reveals new features for the Apple TV 4K and HomePod that are expected to be unveiled next week. Public beta testers won't be able to see these features just yet, however, as the relevant code won't be enabled until the features are officially announced by Apple."}

{'content': '如果你錯過咗之前嘅消息提提你，Apple 預計會喺下星期同十月下旬再次推出新產品。', 'translation': "If you missed our earlier coverage, here's a reminder: Apple is expected to launch new products again next week and in late October."}

{'content': '你已經安裝咗 iPadOS 27.2 公開測試版 2 或者其他更新未？有冇發現到其他新功能？歡迎喺留言區同我哋分享。', 'translation': 'Have you installed iPadOS 27.2 public beta 2 or any of the other updates yet? Spotted any other new features? Drop us a line in the comments.'}
